articles.title: Aetna Approves Coverage for Cleerly's AI Cardiovascular Imaging Analysis
articles.mainIdea: Aetna Approves Coverage for Cleerly's AI Cardiovascular Imaging Analysis
articles.summary: Business Wire: Aetna Approves Coverage for Cleerly's AI Cardiovascular Imaging Analysis. DENVER, January 06, 2026--Cleerly, a leader in AI-based cardiovascular imaging, today announced that Aetna will begin covering Cleerly® LABS plaque analysis effective immediately. Aetna, which covers more than 20+ million lives, joins UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Humana, BCBS Kansas City, Excellus BCBS, and EviCore in providing coverage for this advanced technology.
